# St. Paul Central Mountain Bike Team

> Youth mountain biking team for grades 6-12 in St. Paul, Minnesota. Part of the Minnesota Cycling Association (MCA). The team welcomes riders of all skill levels for coaching, trail rides, and optional racing from July through October across Twin Cities trails including Lebanon Hills, Battle Creek, and Theo Wirth.

The St. Paul Central MTB team is open to students from St. Paul Central, Harding, Johnson, Como Park, and most other St. Paul schools. No prior mountain biking experience is required. Practices are Tuesday and Thursday evenings and Saturday mornings. The season includes five MCA race weekends, though racing is completely optional. Team communication happens through the Heja app.

## Pages

- [Home](https://centralmtb.com/): Overview of the team, season stats, cost breakdown, FAQs, photo gallery, and join link
- [Parent Guide](https://centralmtb.com/parent-guide): Comprehensive guide covering eligibility, practice details, equipment, fees, and frequently asked questions
- [Join the Team](https://centralmtb.com/join): Registration form for new riders
- [Try-Out Ride](https://centralmtb.com/try-out-ride): Information about introductory rides for prospective team members
- [Girls](https://centralmtb.com/girls): Girls-specific riding program and events
- [Equipment Guide](https://centralmtb.com/equipment-guide): Recommended bikes, helmets (MIPS recommended), gloves, eyewear, and other gear
- [Coach Bios](https://centralmtb.com/coach-bios): Profiles and photos of the coaching staff
- [Media](https://centralmtb.com/media): Team photo slideshow and media content
